instructions: This is a Next.js TypeScript starter application for the OpenAI Responses API with multi-turn conversation handling, web search, file search, and function calling capabilities.
Follow these conventions and best practices:
- Use TypeScript with strict typing throughout the codebase
- Follow Next.js 15 App Router patterns for file structure and routing
- Use React functional components with hooks for state management
- Apply Tailwind CSS classes for styling, following the existing design patterns
- Use Zustand for global state management (see stores/ directory)
- Implement proper error handling for API calls and OpenAI operations
- Follow the existing pattern for tool integration in lib/tools/
- Use the established file structure: app/ for pages and API routes, components/ for reusable components, lib/ for utilities
- When working with OpenAI API, use the established assistant.ts patterns for message handling and streaming
- For new components, use the shadcn/ui component library patterns found in components/ui/
- Maintain accessibility standards with proper ARIA attributes and semantic HTML
- Use proper TypeScript interfaces for data structures, especially for OpenAI API responses
- Follow the existing ESLint configuration and coding standards
- When adding new tools or functions, update both the functions mapping and tool definitions
- Use environment variables for sensitive configuration (OPENAI_API_KEY, etc.)
- Implement proper loading states and error boundaries for user interactions
- Follow the existing patterns for file uploads and vector store management

context.purpose: OpenAI Responses API starter application for building conversational assistants
context.architecture: Next.js 15 with TypeScript, App Router, Tailwind CSS, Zustand state management
